reviews.text:
It's been almost 10 years now that we've trusted Muriel at Ac'tifs Canin to groom our dog Happy, and we're still just as happy with her services! 🐶❤️

Over the years, Muriel has always taken care of Happy with great gentleness and professionalism. He's always perfectly groomed, and we know he's in good hands.

And even after moving from Lyon, we still make the trip to see Muriel! 😊 That's how satisfied and appreciative we are of her work.

A huge thank you, Muriel, for all these years and for always taking such good care of Happy. We wholeheartedly recommend Ac'tifs Canin! 🥰🐾

Hello!
I've been having my dog ​​groomed by Muriel for eight years now, and it's always a pleasure to see her take care of our four-legged friends with love and kindness.

I'll never understand the negative reviews from malicious people who insult these canine professionals who keep our pets clean and beautiful every day.

I wholeheartedly recommend Actifs Canin for the well-being and joy that Muriel brings to my Nino.

My 17-year-old dog, Emmie, is always groomed gently and professionally and leaves the salon looking rejuvenated. We've been going there for over 15 years and I'm always very satisfied with the service. I highly recommend it.

I've been taking my little Bichon Frise to Actif Canin for grooming for almost four years now. He always comes out looking impeccable; she follows our instructions perfectly. She's remarkably kind to both us and the animals! It's a pleasure to come to your grooming salon!

I recommend it 100%! Thank you for all these wonderful years of grooming!

My Django has been going to the salon for eight years now. It's always a pleasure to come home to him looking clean, smelling wonderful, and with a perfect trim.
Come without hesitation; your dog will be the happiest.

Muriel is an efficient and experienced professional. Her expertise, patience, and kindness with our dogs ensure that the grooming results meet our expectations and desires. Harkos, Rio, and I highly recommend her.

Cécile

Since moving to Lyon (2018), I've been taking my little poodle, Bambi, to Ac'tifs Canine. Muriel is always smiling and friendly. Every time I pick up Bambi, she's always beautiful and smells wonderful ❤️
I highly recommend them!

My little Nougat has been going to Actif Canin for several years now, and the results are always impeccable. Muriel is very available, responsive, and always accommodating. I highly recommend them; you can leave your little dog with her without hesitation.

I thank Muriel for the care she gave our dog. Her kindness and helpful advice were much appreciated.

The establishment is clean and welcoming, she listens attentively to our concerns, and when we leave, we only want one thing: to entrust our companion to her again for another service. I highly recommend this salon.

Visited in June

I've been a customer for 7 months and I love the service from this wonderful place. My dog ​​is always very clean and is already used to the space. I highly recommend it and I'll be a customer forever, that's for sure!!!

It's always a pleasure to bring my Cavalier King Charles Spaniel to the groomer, and has been for over three years now! I've always been happy with the haircuts I've asked for.

And they're very attentive... because Filou regularly suffers from ear infections, and each time, the grooming is done with a shower cap. No water gets in his ears.

And I love the little extra services (nail trimming or sometimes anal gland expression). It saves me from having to pay for a vet visit.

Thank you!

So, to start, I know that over there 👉 the work is done, so first quality: competence ☝️

She's been grooming my dog ​​for years, and if you're disappointed...😢 go somewhere else lol 😂

And finally, I know she loves dogs, just like me, sometimes even more than people ☝️

The prices are average...on the peninsula, they tend to be a bit...a lot.

I'll add that we communicate a lot, and she's kind and compassionate...this is just my opinion, but personally, in short: it's great 👍 and the lovely manager doesn't hurt! lol 😂
Cheers
“I entrust my dog ​​to you with complete confidence. The work is always impeccable, with great kindness and love for animals. A huge thank you for your professionalism!” 🐶✨ …
They don't accept cards and don't give any advance notice. I had an appointment, took my dog ​​out in the sun, and wasted my time. Appalling service.
Very satisfied with the grooming of my Cavalier King Charles, all my requests were respected to the letter!

Never bring her a dog that isn't supposed to be shaved. Clearly, the owner and only groomer doesn't know how to use scissors. My Cavalier King Charles's usual groomer didn't have any openings to reschedule his appointment before his neutering, which was decided rather quickly. So, I made an appointment at Ac'tifs Canin, thinking it wouldn't be a big deal if it wasn't perfect. I should have been wary of a salon that had openings during the week—mine has a two-month waiting list—and that had no employees or clients before or after my appointment. When she took my dog, I told her I wanted a short scissor cut for his neutering, and she asked, "With clippers?" I repeated, "No, with scissors." She told me to come back in an hour and fifteen minutes, whereas my usual groomer spends over two hours with me. And I understood why: she shaved him completely from his ears to the base of his tail! That was the only instruction she followed; I had asked her not to touch his tail. However, she shaved him very short on the flat surface of his ears, his entire body, his penis, and his testicles. There were razor cuts everywhere. I didn't recognize my dog ​​anymore.

I know that a haircut on a moving dog can't be perfect, but I specifically said twice that I wanted a scissor cut, not clippers, and she charged me the scissor rate. I'm so stupid for having paid.

Very satisfied with my visit!
The groomer was very kind, professional, and attentive to my Pomeranian.
The result is perfect; I highly recommend her!
Today she cut the hair of our Cavalier King Charles Lov’ly and frankly congratulations, she came home looking absolutely gorgeous, a thousand thanks for your professionalism and your work.
Smiling and attentive. She clearly explains what she intends to do and confirms with the dog's owner. Despite his matted fur upon arrival, my dog ​​left looking beautiful and clean.
Super !
Ohio, my little Shih Tzu loves going there, happily goes inside, and is always delighted with the service. A loyal customer for years, I love it and recommend it 200%!

Avoid at all costs!!! The price jumped from €40 to €55 for a tiny dog ​​with short hair. As a result, I picked up my dog, and once I got out of the car, I saw the seat covered in blood!!!! She had cut his paw and hadn't said a word! I used to go there often, but my dog ​​will never set foot in there again!!!!
I took Romeo to the groomer, it was such a treat! He came back all clean, with a perfect trim and smelling divine! Thank you for the haircut 💜 …

I ended up changing grooming salons because my Shih Tzu was consistently returned to me groomed but in poor condition. Cuts under his belly, razor burn (from being shaved too closely), etc... which never happens anymore with my new groomer.
A loyal customer for 7 years, Muriel does a great job

This lady restored our confidence in grooming; she's so helpful and, above all, she puts both the animal and the owner at ease. In our case, it was a miracle; my dog ​​was so happy!
Thank you so much!
Very friendly owner.
